This update is for the SteamOS Beta and Preview channels, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.

These notes contain all changes since the current stable SteamOS 3.9 release, with the changes added since the previous 3.9 beta releases noted below

New in SteamOS 3.9.7
General

Fixed a rare rendering corruption error that would result in white rectangles appearing on the screen in specific situations

Fixed a 3.9 regression with Steam Deck backlight adjustment behavior

Update timezone definitions

Security and stability updates

SteamOS 3.9.6
General

Improved frame timing when using the framerate limiter with VRR.

Improved frame timing when using the framerate limiter without VRR. A capped game whose framerate is a multiple of the limit no longer drops below it, e.g. a 30 FPS game with a 60 FPS limit at 120 Hz running at 24 FPS.

Reduced missed frames on fixed refresh caused by slow wakeups from deep CPU idle states.

Fixed a black screen in RPG Maker games using Fullscreen++, such as Waste Walkers.

Fixed games running below the refresh rate on 240 Hz and higher displays.

Fixed Steam Remote Play showing a green screen on NVIDIA GPUs.

Fixed left click getting stuck after a two-finger tap on the touchscreen.

Fixed SDR content looking oversaturated on HDR10 output on displays that are not wide gamut.

Fixed gamemode and other LD_PRELOAD libraries breaking when launched through gamescope.

Fixed several rare crashes and memory errors on shutdown and when clients exit.

Desktop Mode

Fixed a regression where scripts couldn't be added using "Add to Steam"

articles.description:
We want to share an update on Steam Machine reservations. We've been able to fulfill all current reservations for the 512GB model with no waitlist remaining, and have wrapped up sending purchase invites out to all remaining 2TB reservation holders.
However, we are continuing to encounter supply constraints for hardware components, which impacts our ability to source parts. 
For Steam Machine, that is especially impacting the 2TB model, where the number of customers on the waitlist exceeds our current production; even when we are able to build more it will be at smaller quantities than we planned.

Here's what this means for each model:

Steam Machine 512GB:

Steam Machine 512GB is now in an add-to-cart status, and you can purchase one directly while supplies last.

If and when we get through current inventory, we will flip it to out-of-stock rather than begin building another waitlist.

Steam Machine 2TB:

We've finished getting purchase invites out to all reservation holders.

Those currently on the waitlist will retain their position in line. As always, no one on the waitlist is guaranteed a unit.

Because there are more people on the waitlist than units available, we are closing the waitlist to additional signups. The language on the product page will change from "add to waitlist" to "out of stock."

If you are on this waitlist, you are welcome to choose to purchase a 512GB model instead (while supplies last). Please note that doing so requires leaving your spot on the waitlist.

We expect to have more details to share in January about additional supply. 

What's next:
We are continuing to build more Steam Machine units, but memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them. The 2TB model in particular will be especially constrained.
We anticipate having more information to share come January.

This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested.
You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.



Camera Pass Through / Room View:

PC Streaming now supports chroma key to allow Room View to be shown on VR content.

Settings are located on the PC side in the Camera section, including a mode switch between Protect Content and Key Content. Key Content will allow any game to simply draw the key color to control Room View transparency.  

Note: this feature requires also opting into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC
To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta.


General

Foveated sharpening is now applied when streaming VR through Steam Link.

Added accessibility settings for prism correction (diplopia).
Toggle Advanced Settings, then General > Accessibility > Prism Correction. Needs to restart the headset to take effect.

Fixed a visual glitch when opening/closing the dashboard in some games.

Fixed WebXR support in Chrome/Chromium when installed as user (instead of system-wide) from Discover.

Fixed a system lock-up caused by certain apps installed from Discover (eg: VLC).

Linked the Show Perf Overlay in VR and Draw Performance Assessment toggles together. Turning off Show Perf Overlay in VR also disables the developer overlay.

articles.title: Steam Client Update - November 11th

articles.description:
Today, the recent achievements update featuring Steam Achievement Sets and a new achievements page, is available to all Steam users.
Achievement Sets are ideal for organizing achievements within a game, making it easier for players to track their progress and discover new achievements as games add them. They also allow games to add new achievements, or new DLC with achievements, without breaking prior game completion.


You can read the full blog post here, but here's a quick summary...
Track progress by achievement set - You can track progress across each achievement set in a game, each with their own progress bar and trophy.
Keep game completion intact - If new achievements are added to a game, it won't break previously completed sets or take away your game completion.
DLC achievements - Achievements can now be tied to DLC and can be organized into their own sets, with progress reflected separately from the base game.
Complete games or sets with retired achievements - Developers can archive or retire achievements and sets when they're no longer available, preserving them for players who earned them without affecting future completion for everyone else.

We've also revamped the achievements page to bring together overall game progress, individual set progress, achievement details, Global Stats, and expanded search and filtering. Enjoy competing with friends? Players can now compare their achievements progress with up to three friends, based on a more accurate total achievement count.

Throughout the beta, we've continued to make improvements based on feedback from both players and developers, and we'll continue to do so. We'd like to thank everyone who participated and took the time to share their thoughts. 

Are you a game developer interested in seeing how easy it is to add achievement sets? Read the Steamworks blog post here.

SteamOS 0.5.8 (for Steam Frame) has just been released.
This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested.
You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.



Camera Pass Through / Room View:

PC Streaming now supports Room View. Previously, enabling Room View would hide remote content.

You can now see remote desktop / remote game theater while camera passthrough is active.

PC VR games with OpenXR mixed reality support are now able to blend VR content and camera passthrough. (Example: X-Plane 12)


Note: this feature requires also opting into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC
To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta.


General

Overlay render quality is now always set to Low on Steam Frame, and the option is hidden. This fixes problems that happened when Ultra was selected.

Improved eye tracking self-calibration.

Fixed low-end gamma response, including inconsistencies between eyes, on some headsets.

Fixed a permission issue that prevented WebXR from working in Chrome v157.


Developers:

Allows OpenXR games streamed from PC to use [c]XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND[/c].


SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.2.

To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta.


General

Improved eye tracking self-calibration.

Fixed low-end gamma response, including inconsistencies between eyes, on some headsets.

Fixed a permission issue that prevented WebXR from working in Chrome v157.

Allows OpenXR games streamed from PC to use [c]XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND[/c].
